title: AI & Machine Learning Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk exposure from AI tools, machine learning platforms, and automated data collection. Get personalized protection tips.
description: Assess how AI services and machine learning platforms may be collecting, analyzing, and using your personal data. Get a personalized privacy risk score and actionable steps to protect yourself from AI-powered surveillance and data harvesting.

inputs.label: How frequently do you use AI tools (ChatGPT, Bard, etc.)?
inputs.helpText: AI chatbots and tools collect conversation data to improve their models

inputs.label: Do you share personal information with AI tools?
inputs.helpText: Personal data in AI prompts can be stored and used for training

inputs.label: How often are you exposed to facial recognition systems?
inputs.helpText: Public cameras with AI increasingly use facial recognition technology

inputs.label: How much do you use AI-powered social media platforms?
inputs.helpText: Social platforms use AI to analyze your behavior, posts, and connections

inputs.label: How many app permissions do you typically grant?
inputs.helpText: App permissions enable AI-powered data collection from your device

inputs.label: Do you use privacy-focused browsers or tools?
inputs.helpText: Privacy browsers like Incognito Browser reduce AI tracking and data collection

inputs.label: Have you opted out of AI training data collection?
inputs.helpText: Many AI services allow you to opt out of using your data for model training

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall privacy risk from AI and machine learning systems (0-100)

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Your privacy risk category with recommendations

outputFields.label: Data Exposure Rating
outputFields.description: How much personal data you're potentially exposing to AI systems

formula: const aiUsageScore = { never: 0, rarely: 10, sometimes: 25, often: 40, constantly: 60 }[aiToolUsage]; const personalDataScore = { never: 0, minimal: 5, sometimes: 15, often: 30, everything: 50 }[personalDataSharing]; const faceRecScore = { minimal: 0, low: 5, moderate: 15, high: 25, constant: 35 }[faceRecognitionExposure]; const socialScore = { none: 0, minimal: 5, moderate: 15, heavy: 25, maximum: 35 }[socialMediaUsage]; const permissionScore = { minimal: 0, limited: 5, some: 10, many: 20, all: 30 }[devicePermissions]; const privacyReduction = privacyTools ? -15 : 0; const optOutReduction = dataOptOuts ? -10 : 0; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, aiUsageScore + personalDataScore + faceRecScore + socialScore + permissionScore + privacyReduction + optOutReduction)); const riskLevel = riskScore < 20 ? 'Low Risk' : riskScore < 40 ? 'Moderate Risk' : riskScore < 60 ? 'High Risk' : 'Very High Risk'; const dataExposure = riskScore < 25 ? 'A' : riskScore < 45 ? 'B' : riskScore < 65 ? 'C' : riskScore < 80 ? 'D' : 'F'; return { riskScore, riskLevel, dataExposure };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your privacy risk based on AI tool usage patterns, personal data sharing habits, exposure to AI-powered surveillance systems, and current privacy protection measures. Scores are weighted based on the privacy impact of different AI technologies and data collection methods.
tips: Use privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser when interacting with AI tools
Avoid sharing personal, sensitive, or identifying information in AI chat prompts
Regularly review and limit app permissions on your devices
Opt out of AI training data collection in service settings when possible
Use strong privacy settings on social media platforms
Consider wearing face coverings in high-surveillance areas
Read AI service privacy policies before using new tools
Use VPNs when accessing AI services to mask your location data

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: You have good privacy practices with AI services. Continue being cautious with personal data sharing.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy concerns with AI usage. Consider implementing additional privacy measures.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure to AI systems. Review your data sharing practices and increase privacy protections.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Extensive privacy exposure to AI data collection. Immediate action needed to protect your personal information.
